content: Dashboard UX best practice for data freshness: show an explicit timestamp ('Updated 08:35 UTC') rather than a vague relative time; stale data should look visually different (muted/greyed) from fresh data; a small freshness-status widget (Live/Stale/Paused + manual refresh) builds trust; when data is delayed or missing, tell the user what is known/unknown and suggest next action rather than silently showing gaps as zeros or blanks.
